The Board of Directors of the Federal Bank for Co﷓operatives

The Board of Directors of
the Federal Bank for Co-operatives & Regulation of Co-operative Banking
(Meetings) Rules, 1977
Published
in the Gazette of West Pakistan. Extraordinary. Part II. dated 18-5-1977. pp.
837-838.
Notification No. S.R.O. 427 (1)/77?
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 50 of the Establishment of the
Federal Bank for Co-operatives and Regulation of Co-operative Banking Act, 1977
(IX of 1977), the Board of Directors, with the approval of the Federal
Government is pleased to make the following rules or regulation of its
meetings, namely:--
1. These rules may be called the
Board of Directors of the Federal Bank for Co-operatives and Regulations of Co-operative
Banking (Meetings) Rules, 1977.
2. The meetings of the Board
shall be convened by or under the orders of the Chairman or, in his absence by
the Managing Director, not less than [four]
times in each calendar year and not less than once in each quarter. Subs. by S.R.O 211(1)/89 dated 8-3-1989.
3. Any four Directors may require
the Chairman or the Managing Director, as the case may be, to convene a meeting
of the Board and the Chairman or the Managing Director shall forthwith take or
cause steps to be taken to convene a meeting accordingly.
(1) Ordinarily fifteen days clear
notice shall be given of each meeting of the Board and such notice shall be
sent to every Director at his registered address.
(2) In the case of an emergency
meeting, sufficient notice shall be given to every Director, who is at the time
in Pakistan, to enable him to attend.
4. No business other than that
for which the meeting was convened shall be discussed at a meeting of the
Board, except, with the consent of the Chairman and the majority of the
Directors present, unless a notice of one clear week has been given of the same
in writing to the Chairman.
5. The Chairman or; in his
absence, the Managing Director may cancel, postpone and adjourn a meeting of
the Board.
6. A copy of the proceedings of
each meeting of the Board shall be circulated as soon as possible after the
meeting for the information of the Directors and shall be signed by the
Chairman at that or 'the next .succeeding meeting.
7. Every Director shall. before
entering upon his office, sign a declaration in the form set out in the schedule
annexed to these rules.
8. (1) Every Director, who is
directly or indirectly concerned or interested in any contract or arrangement
entered into by or on behalf of the Bank, shall disclose the nature of his
interest at the meeting of the Board at which the contract or arrangement is
determined if his interest then exists, or in any other case at the next
meeting of the Board after the acquisition of his interest or the making of the
contract or the arrangement.
(2) No Director shall vote on any
contract or arrangement in which he is either directly of indirectly concerned
or interested and if he does so, his vote shall not be counted.
9. The Board may constitute
committees consisting of its members for special purposes, provided that the Managing
Director shall be one of their members and the Boards may fix the terms of
reference and the rules of procedures for such committees.
